tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work through review and discussion

tasks.design: Keep review and supervisory discussion with the teacher. Work held in {LMS} can support the discussion, but no separate tracking or scheduling share is established by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful guidance depends on understanding both the work and the student's context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in this supervisory interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Placement conditions and developing independence require individual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when guidance should challenge, support or redirect the student.
tasks.altitude: Supervision responsibilities and contact time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How to give guidance without doing the student's work

evidence.claim: Supervisory review and discussion remain human work; formative feedback capability does not establish a reduction in supervision time.

assumptions: Boundary is supervision, excluding separate grading, original student work and placement administration. Those actors and tasks retain their effort.

Students produce work before review; placement supervisors supply observations before or during discussion before the teacher closes guidance. The teacher verifies context and clarifies progress within s1; no free student-readiness flag is assumed.
Native work access precedes custom code. No new service or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current supervision scope and placement feedback arrangements
research_questions: Is any recurring clerical follow-up distinguishable from necessary supervisory discussion?

already_counted.description: Work review and individual supervisory discussion

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. No separate supervision paperwork baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate curricula, course content and methods and define intended revisions
Revise course materials and instructional examples from the teacher's brief

loop.purpose: Draft changes to selected course materials
loop.input: Teacher's revision brief, selected original passages and verified sources
loop.output: Tracked material changes with source references
loop.check: Teacher checks disciplinary accuracy, learning alignment, accessibility and whether examples actually teach the intended distinction
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported examples or sources return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations and examples require tailored wording; templates handle only fixed structure

steps.what: Evaluate the revised materials and accept the course content revision

tasks.design: Use a bounded drafting aid in {DOCS} for selected material revisions after the teacher evaluates the course. Keep curriculum choices, factual checking and acceptance human; neither student grading nor curriculum governance is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rewording and creating examples followed an already determined pedagogical change.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bounded draft can offer material variants against an explicit teacher brief.
tasks.still_hard: Plausible examples can teach the wrong concept or misrepresent a source.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what students need to learn and whether the revised material will help them learn it.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft wording; pedagogical evaluation and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review alignment of materials and outcomes
reach.learn: How to test whether examples and activities support an outcome

evidence.claim: EduGenAI is an educational chat pilot; its availability supports access to a drafting interface, not demonstrated curriculum quality or savings.
Bounded material revision and the local savings estimate are an unmeasured E1 design.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher-controlled curriculum and material revision, excluding original research, student assessment and formal programme approval. Existing governance remains unchanged outside this contribution.

The teacher creates outcome, topic, learner level, source version, selected passages, example constraints and revision rationale in s1; all evaluation and capture occupy 35 hours. Missing evidence is resolved manually before drafting. No free effective-material or approved-curriculum flag is assumed.
Test approved native document assistance before code; exclude identifiable student work unless access is authorized. Existing templates earn no new saving.
unknowns: Current material revision effort and tool permissions
research_questions: Do teacher-checked drafts reduce wording time while preserving accurate examples and learning alignment?

approvals.approved_version: Exact curriculum revision, learning outcomes, examples, source references and material text accepted by the teacher; edits void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=87.75, gross=12.25, upkeep=6, net=6.25. Range 0-3 allows source checking, original example development or infrequent revision to consume most drafting gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address teaching and research issues

tasks.design: Keep collaborative problem-solving with the participating teachers. {DOCS} supports existing evidence sharing; no distinct meeting preparation or minutes baseline is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Colleagues need to reconcile different experience and views of the issue.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a shorter collaborative decision process.
tasks.still_hard: A shared problem definition may matter more than an immediate proposed answer.
tasks.human_edge: Question assumptions, negotiate practical changes and understand colleague concerns.
tasks.altitude: Collegial participation and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How to convert different observations into a testable change

evidence.claim: Collegial teaching and research problem-solving is interpersonal judgement work without a demonstrated separate reducible administrative share.

assumptions: Boundary is collaboration, excluding implementation, research execution and curriculum drafting counted in 6294. Colleagues' participation remains unchanged outside focal time.

Participants produce concerns and perspectives before or during s1, then clarify proposed actions before discussion closes. The teacher's interpretation and capture stay within s1; no free agreed-solution flag is assumed.
Native document sharing precedes custom code. No new tool or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current collaboration format and decision scope
research_questions: What makes an issue require repeated collegial discussion before action is clear?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and net=0 with zero upkeep. No meeting or research judgement time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Verify academic and vocational curricula information relevant to the student's question
Advise students on academic choices and career issues through individual discussion

tasks.design: Keep current-information verification in {DOCS} and individual advice with the teacher. No maintained course-rule service or repeated answer baseline is assumed to exist free of capture and upkeep.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on current options and the student's goals and constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes reduced time for this advice boundary.
tasks.still_hard: A formally possible route may not suit the student's circumstances or career aims.
tasks.human_edge: Help students evaluate choices without turning uncertain career outcomes into promises.
tasks.altitude: Advice responsibilities remain unchanged; admissions and exemption rights are not added.

reach.learn: How programme requirements constrain possible study routes

evidence.claim: Student advice combines current-information verification and individual discussion; no automated eligibility decision or established retrieval saving is proposed.

assumptions: Boundary is advice, excluding admission, exemption, grade decisions and specialist career services. Those authorities retain their existing work.

The student supplies the initial question before s1 and personal circumstances during s2. Programme staff publish curriculum information before s1; the teacher checks version, applicability and uncertainty within its 25 hours. No structured eligible-pathway or career-fit flag is assumed.
Test native curriculum access before custom code if repeated lookup burden is measured. No new service means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Current curriculum source quality and referral arrangements
research_questions: Which advice questions depend on unpublished or ambiguous curriculum requirements?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Current source verification and personal advice both retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A bounded material draft may reduce wording effort; supervision, collegial work and student advice retain human time.
reach: Work with an instructional coordinator on learning alignment and pathway clarity
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who can revise communications materials efficiently while preserving disciplinary judgement and student contact.
